summary: Correct the asset boundary to Collectif Santé Montréal S.E.C., retain the hospital name as display identity and remove unsupported Equitix attribution. OHLA sold its 25% stake to John Laing Health Montreal Limited with a November 28, 2024 close, and AtkinsRéalis directly reports a 10% HMC L.P. interest acquired March 4, 2024 and still held at year-end 2025. The original 2011 syndicate was 30% Innisfree, 25% OHL, 25% Explore Santé Montréal and 20% Dalkia. Current ownership of the remaining 65% is unresolved, so application is blocked.
